text:
Ara: Hey team, seeing a weird p99 latency bump on dedicated-uk-1 starting ~02:10 UTC. Root cause looks like sudden KV cache churn when we get long-context (80k+) streaming requests.
Kevin: Can you paste the svcruntime logs? any evict entries?
Ara: snippet: `evict: policy=fifo, reason=memory_pressure, reclaimed=12, pages=3` and at same time `streamer: latency_ms=382, p99=412`. Not pure OOM, just a lot of paging.
Maria: FIFO under sustained long contexts could be evicting hot KV pages that LRU would keep. Did the rollout to fifo-default happen last week?
Ara: Yes, rolled last Wed to test lower metadata overhead. We bumped `--kv-evict-policy=fifo` and `--kv-page-size=256MB`.
Sam: I ran a quick profile with `perf` + Flamegraph on a repro cluster. Hot path is `kv_reinsert()` + `pager_fetch()` loop, heatmap shows repeated re-adds for same key within seconds.
Jon: That smells like reinsert thrash: FIFO evicts earliest entries regardless of reuse probability. For long contexts, reuse correlates with recency, so LRU wins.
Maria: Are we sure it's correctness and not a bug where evicted entries aren't marked cleanly so reinsert increments frag? Any tombstones?
Ara: Logs show `tombstone_set=true` occasionally. We saw `pager: stale_ref_count=4` right before a latency spike.
Kevin: Could also be allocator fragmentation — small KV slices + page boundaries cause more copies on reinsert. Do we have heap profiles?
Sam: Heap profile attached to the thread (uploaded to infra): large number of short-lived buffers from `kv_clone_entry()`. I can attach command: `pprof -http=:6060 srv:6060` on repro.
ci-bot: deploy/rollback check: last config change was `config: runtime-kv-policy=fifo` on 1712290000 by infra-svc.
Jon: Suggested mitigation: revert policy to LRU on a canary node, enable `kv-evict-sane-threshold=0.85`, and add `reinsert-backoff=50ms` to reduce immediate readds.
Ara: I'll spin a canary with LRU and backoff. If p99 goes back down, we confirm policy mismatch.
Maria: Also add a unit test for tombstone cleanup and a small fuzz run: simulate 10k long-context sessions with mixed seq lengths to catch reinsert races.
Kevin: For action items: (1) canary revert to LRU (Ara), (2) add tombstone/gc test (Maria), (3) memory+heap perf capture on canary (Sam), (4) blamelist/rollout note for infra (Jon).
Ara: Filed a brief runbook in tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1245 — includes repro script: `scripts/repro/kv-thrash.sh --clients=200 --ctx=80k` and perf capture steps.
Sam: One more note — if we can't revert fast, we can temporarily raise `kv-pool-max` to avoid paging at the cost of memory. That buys time for a full fix.
Jon: Agreed. Let's keep an eye on dedicated-uk-1 dashboards for 1h after canary.
Ara: Thanks all, will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
